paragraphs: simpledu sells dismissal and discipline systems for K-12 schools. simpldiscipline is a behavior referral and discipline management system built to make discipline reporting, management, and oversight easier for schools. simpldismissal covers afternoon dismissal, with students dismissed from an interactive dismissal board direct from their classroom.

Buyers named on these pages are schools and school districts. simpledu supports schools across 14 states, and simpldiscipline serves over 50% of school districts in South Carolina. Customer testimonials name Chesterfield County Schools (SC), Darlington County School District (SC), and School District of Pickens County (SC).

simpledu began in 2020 as a side project and has stayed bootstrapped, with no shareholders and no outside investors. The team is described as coming from K-12 backgrounds, including teachers, technologists, and data specialists.

quote.text: Making K-12 simple — one data sync at a time.
